verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single claim that Earth Class Mail securely stores received mail and lets users forward physical items wherever needed. That implies some choice over what happens to each physical item, but nothing documents storage durations, shredding, or a fuller set of disposal options. Missing for 10: documented storage windows/retention periods, on-request shredding with confirmation, explicit per-item disposal options beyond forwarding, independent corroboration.
